```artifact
Feature: System Backup and Reporting

  Scenario: System Backup
    Given the system is running
    When the backup process is triggered
    Then the backup files are created and sent to the remote site
    And the backup files are rotated every 30 days

  Scenario: User Password Change
    Given a user is logged in
    When the user changes their password
    Then the new password is stored in the database
    And the user can log in with the new password

  Scenario: Patient Registration
    Given a patient is registering
    When the patient creates a user ID and password
    Then the patient can log in with the user ID and password

  Scenario: Doctor Wise Appointment Report
    Given the system has appointment data
    When the report is generated for the next 5 days
    Then the report shows the appointments for the next 5 days

  Scenario: Speciality Wise Consultation Report
    Given the system has consultation data
    When the report is generated for the last day of the month
    Then the report shows the number of consultations by doctor per month

  Scenario: Speciality Wise Revenue Report
    Given the system has revenue data
    When the report is generated for the last day of the month
    Then the report shows the revenue earned per month

  Scenario Outline: Backup Rotation
    Given the system has backup files
    When the backup rotation process is triggered
    Then the backup files are rotated every 30 days
    Examples:
      | days |
      | 29  |
      | 30  |
      | 31  |

  Scenario Outline: Report Boundary Tests
    Given the system has data for the last day of the month
    When the report is generated for the last day of the month
    Then the report shows the correct data
    Examples:
      | month | year |
      | 1     | 2022 |
      | 2     | 2022 |
      | 12    | 2022 |

  Scenario Outline: Password Change Tests
    Given a user is logged in
    When the user changes their password
    Then the new password is stored in the database
    Examples:
      | old_password | new_password |
      | password123  | password456  |
      | password456  | password789  |
      | password789  | password012  |
      | password012  | password345  |
      | password345  | password678  |

  Scenario Outline: Report Data Tests
    Given the system has data for the last day of the month
    When the report is generated for the last day of the month
    Then the report shows the correct data
    Examples:
      | month | year | data |
      | 1     | 2022 | 100  |
      | 2     | 2022 | 200  |
      | 12    | 2022 | 300  |
```
